project.description:
Use this job to import the columnMeta.csv for 'Dictionary ETL - BDC Ingest Pipeline' usage
On successfu build run 'Dictionary ETL - BDC Ingest Pipeline' will auto trigger build.
FAQ Out of boundary columnMeta.csv location? s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
set -eou pipefail
zstd -d -f columnMeta.csv.zst
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp columnMeta.csv s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv
